answer.rationale: c2 directly supports moving primary supply to the low-cost vendor; the finance mandate requires an 18% unit-cost cut and the incumbent will not renegotiate this cycle. c2 confirms a prior low-cost vendor move delivered sharp unit-cost reduction with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, which is exactly the lever needed to hit the mandate without expanding the supplier base or adding integration risk. With the contract expiring in 14 days, the single allowable decision should be the cost-out action; delivery risk is bounded because the incumbent is being replaced on a defined timeline rather than via parallel dual-sourcing during a shortage.
